d.ko: Battle the corrupt animals of the forest, collect valuable items and abilities, and save the world, TWICE, in this retro-styled RPG adventure! As an official spinoff of the Five Nights at Freddy's horror game series, you can expect familiar characters, loads of secrets, and maybe some scares...

rv.t: "9x년대 그래픽으로 만든 스타듀밸리느낌을 주나 싶지만 실상은 턴제 전투하는 스타듀포켓몬스터" 근데 게임 자체가 못 만든건 아님. 미스터리한 스토리 해결도 탄탄하고, 전투장면이랑 브금도 나쁘지않음. 겜 자체 각 잡고 하면 5~60시간은 해야 엔딩을 볼수있음.

A pixel art retro RPG spinoff of a horror franchise that's every bit as cool as it sounds. P.S. - Still not going to Freddy's. Even if I haven't had a pizza in 3 years. P.P.S. - When Is FNAF gonna do a "survivor-like" game?

POPGOES Arcade is such a hidden gem, especially if you love retro RPGs or just enjoy diving into deep, spooky lore. It completely subverts expectations by taking turn-based, 8-bit combat and mixing it with a genuinely eerie atmosphere …
